rules.name: supply_backed
rules.why: suppliers backed by cash plus loans

rules.name: borrow_healthy
rules.expr: ok and called("borrow") and post("debtOf", sender) > (((post("collateralOf", sender) * ((post("AmmC04.reserve0") * 1000000000000000000) // post("AmmC04.reserve1"))) // 1000000000000000000) * 7500) // 10000

rules.name: withdrawcol_healthy
rules.expr: ok and called("withdrawCollateral") and post("debtOf", sender) > (((post("collateralOf", sender) * ((post("AmmC04.reserve0") * 1000000000000000000) // post("AmmC04.reserve1"))) // 1000000000000000000) * 7500) // 10000

rules.name: liq_close_factor
rules.why: at most half the debt per liquidation

rules.name: liq_seize_bound
rules.expr: ok and called("liquidate") and pre("collateralOf", arg(0)) > post("collateralOf", arg(0)) + (((arg(1) * 1000000000000000000) // ((pre("AmmC04.reserve0") * 1000000000000000000) // pre("AmmC04.reserve1"))) * 10500) // 10000
rules.why: seized collateral <= repaid value plus 5% bonus

rules.name: liq_debt_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("liquidate") and (post("debtOf", arg(0)) + arg(1) != pre("debtOf", arg(0)) or post("totalBorrowed") + arg(1) != pre("totalBorrowed"))
rules.why: liquidation reduces debt by exactly repayAmount

rules.name: liq_pays
rules.expr: ok and called("liquidate") and post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) + arg(1)

rules.name: liq_col_out
rules.expr: ok and called("liquidate") and sender != A0 and pre("collateralOf", arg(0)) + pre("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", sender) != post("collateralOf", arg(0)) + post("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", sender)

rules.name: supply_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("supply") and (post("supplied", sender) != pre("supplied", sender) + arg(0) or post("totalSupplied") != pre("totalSupplied") + arg(0) or post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0))

rules.name: withdrawsupply_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdrawSupply") and (post("supplied", sender) + arg(0) != pre("supplied", sender) or post("totalSupplied") + arg(0) != pre("totalSupplied") or post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: depositcol_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("depositCollateral") and (post("collateralOf", sender) != pre("collateralOf", sender) + arg(0) or post("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0))

rules.name: withdrawcol_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdrawCollateral") and (post("collateralOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("collateralOf", sender) or post("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: withdrawcol_limit
rules.why: cannot withdraw more collateral than owned

rules.name: borrow_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("borrow") and (post("debtOf", sender) != pre("debtOf", sender) + arg(0) or post("totalBorrowed") != pre("totalBorrowed") + arg(0) or post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: repay_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("repay") and arg(1) <= pre("debtOf", arg(0)) and (post("debtOf", arg(0)) + arg(1) != pre("debtOf", arg(0)) or post("totalBorrowed") + arg(1) != pre("totalBorrowed") or post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) + arg(1))

rules.name: repay_capped
rules.expr: ok and called("repay") and arg(1) > pre("debtOf", arg(0)) and (post("debtOf", arg(0)) != 0 or post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", A0) + pre("debtOf", arg(0)))
rules.why: overpaying repay is capped at debt

rules.name: repay_no_collateral_change
rules.expr: ok and called("repay") and post("collateralOf", u) != pre("collateralOf", u)

rules.name: debt_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("debtOf", u) > pre("debtOf", u)
rules.why: nobody gets debt from others' calls

rules.name: supplied_third_party
rules.why: nobody loses supply in others' calls

rules.name: collateral_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and not called("liquidate") and post("collateralOf", u) < pre("collateralOf", u)

rules.name: liq_only_target
rules.expr: ok and called("liquidate") and u != arg(0) and u != sender and post("collateralOf", u) != pre("collateralOf", u)

rules.name: tokens_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("supply") or called("withdrawSupply") or called("depositCollateral") or called("withdrawCollateral") or called("borrow") or called("repay") or called("liquidate")) and u != sender and u != A0 and u != A3 and (post("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC04_USDS.balanceOf", u) or post("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC04_GCOL.balanceOf", u))
rules.why: lending calls never take tokens from non-callers

params.condition: pre("debtOf", sender) == 0 and arg(0) <= pre("collateralOf", sender) and sender != A0
